title: Jazz Jam Session @ The Green Room at Crosstown Arts
event_description: Monthly jazz jam hosted by the Alex Upton Quartet. Musicians of all ages and backgrounds join for spontaneous improvisation and repertoire exploration. Free for participants.
event_time_plain: 7:00 PM - 10:30 PM (Doors at 7:00 PM and Show at 7:30 PM)
venue_name: The Green Room at Crosstown Arts
backline: Piano bass drums and professional sound system
event_venue_information:
About The Green Room

The Green Room at Crosstown Arts is a premier listening room committed to providing optimal conditions for both artists and audiences. Located within the historic Crosstown Concourse building the venue features carefully considered acoustic treatments and state-of-the-art lighting and a premiere sound system.

The Jazz Jam

The monthly Alex Upton Jazz Jam brings together seasoned professionals and emerging talent for collaborative music-making. Participants tackle the expansive jazz repertoire in an inclusive environment that fosters networking and community building. The jam features a professional backline including piano bass and drums.

Other Programming

Crosstown Arts hosts a variety of music events throughout the year from intimate jazz performances to national touring acts. The venue is part of a larger contemporary arts organization offering galleries residencies and educational programming.

title: 1st Sunday Jazz Jam Pop Up Series @ Center for Southern Folklore
event_description: Monthly jazz jam featuring seasoned musicians and local talent. An afternoon of smooth jazz in an intimate setting with Memphis soul food and cultural atmosphere.
event_venue_information:
About Center for Southern Folklore

The Center for Southern Folklore is a historic venue located in downtown Memphis dedicated to celebrating the arts music and heritage of the South. Operating since 1974 the Center documents and presents the music culture and rhythms of the Memphis Delta region.

The Jazz Jam

Founded by Cequita Monique the 1st Sunday Jazz Jam Pop Up Series brings funky engaging jazz to downtown Memphis. The event features both established musicians like Stephen Lee (founder of Memphis Jazz Workshop) and emerging artists. Food drinks and desserts are available for purchase.

Food & Atmosphere

The cafe specializes in traditional Southern food including famous mac and cheese greens chili tamales cornbread and legendary peach cobbler. Live performances typically occur Friday and Saturday nights with the jazz jam highlighting Sundays.

title: Blues Jam @ Hard Rock Cafe Beale Street
event_description: Weekly blues jam session featuring mid-south's best blues musicians. Memphis Blues Society hosts this community jam with professional backline and supportive atmosphere.
day: Second Third Fourth Sundays (and Fifth when applicable)
backline: Drum set 2 guitar amps bass amp and keyboard
event_venue_information:
About Hard Rock Cafe Memphis

Located on the historic Beale Street Hard Rock Cafe Memphis provides a tourist-friendly venue with professional equipment and a welcoming atmosphere for both musicians and blues enthusiasts.

The Blues Jam

Hosted by the Memphis Blues Society these Sunday jams feature a house band that starts and ends each session with open slots for community musicians in between. The jam follows traditional etiquette: musicians sign up in advance take short solos and respect the equipment. All skill levels welcome but participants must be sober and ready to perform when called.

Equipment

The venue provides a full backline including drums guitar amps bass amp and keyboard. Musicians must bring their own instruments (guitar and bass) and drummers must bring sticks. The Memphis Blues Society maintains high standards for equipment care and jam session conduct.

title: Sunday Blues Jam @ Wild Bill's
event_description: Sunday afternoon blues jam session at Memphis's legendary juke joint. Open to all musicians - guitarists drummers singers and more join the Juke Joint AllStars house band.
hosts: Don Valentine and The Juke Joint AllStars
event_venue_information:
About Wild Bill's

Wild Bill's is Memphis's last surviving authentic Delta juke joint located in the historic Vollintine-Evergreen neighborhood. Operating for over 25 years this legendary venue offers an unfiltered authentic blues experience far from the polished tourist venues of Beale Street.

The Sunday Jam

Every Sunday afternoon Wild Bill's hosts a blues jam session where visiting musicians can join the house band led by Don Valentine and The Juke Joint AllStars. Unlike the late-night shows the Sunday jam runs in the early evening making it accessible for families and early birds. Musicians bring instruments and join in - guitars drums vocals even tambourine players are welcomed on stage.

Atmosphere & Food

The venue features red walls intimate communal seating and an authentic juke joint atmosphere. Soul Food Sundays offer traditional Southern cuisine. The venue operates on a BYOB liquor policy (beer sold on-site) with mixers and ice available. Cover charges apply for evening shows but the Sunday jam maintains an accessible community-focused vibe.

Regular Programming

Friday and Saturday nights feature the Juke Joint AllStars performing from 11 PM to 3 AM. Thursday nights offer Don Valentine Big Blues. The venue is known for spontaneous performances with musicians often arriving mid-set to join the band.
